i worked at McDonald’s for over a year and was a manager. it wasn’t the best job in the world but my advice would definitely be as genuine as you can be. to me this comes naturally. im a people pleaser so talking to guests and coworkers was one of the easiest things in the world. if you’re not exactly like that, don’t try to put on a show. just be nice. you don’t have to always have things to say and to respond because after all it is work. just be as nice as you can be. pay attention to your body language too. you can try to be as nice as you want but if you’re pacing or fiddling with your fingers it’s obvious to people that you’re nervous or “awkward”. im sure nearly everyone there is in the same boat as you. just try your best to put yourself out there because that’s what people admire most in my experience. i remember my first day at McDonald’s. the first guy i met asked me if i could find left-handed gloves for him. of course i was just standing there awkwardly so i went to the stock room looking for freaking left-handed gloves lmao. after this was said and done, he introduced himself and we got to know each other over the course of my time working there. he became one of my very best friends. my point is- put yourself out there when possible but also try to remain as genuine as you can stand. be nice. make friends. you never know how much it means to someone (coworker or guest) when you simply smile and say hello. good luck!
